summary: Backend-only smoke regression (curl, no browser) for Phase-1 native/mobile auth contract on RealAICoach. All 7 requested checks PASSED. Web cookie path and native Bearer path both verified against admin credentials; /api/admin/scaling/status still contains llm_circuit_breaker (previous feature intact); Expo native manifest served on localhost:3001 with expo-platform: android returns valid JSON with name=RealAICoach.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/auth.py L192-200 _allow_native_auth_tokens correctly gates token-in-body on X-Client-Platform in {mobile,native,android,ios,expo} (or X-Auth-Channel). Verified: web (no header) -> no token in body; mobile header -> token in body. Contract holds.

routes/auth.py L279-292 _auth_token_payload returns {} when web-origin, so session_token stays in httpOnly cookie only — matches security posture in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. No leakage regression detected.

routes/auth.py L7012 /auth/me depends on get_current_user which per files_of_reference (routes/db.py:703) prefers Authorization Bearer then cookie fallback — verified end-to-end: same admin user resolved via both channels.
test_credentials: admin@realaicoach.app / NewAdminPass2026! - verified working on both web-cookie and native-bearer paths
seed_data_creation: None - read-only verification, no data mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Native (mobile) auth contract lives at routes/auth.py L192-200 (_allow_native_auth_tokens) and L279-292 (_auth_token_payload). To exercise the token-in-body path, send header 'X-Client-Platform: mobile' (or native/android/ios/expo) with the login POST; response JSON will include session_token. Then use 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' on /api/auth/me to prove Bearer end-to-end (no cookie required). Web path (no X-Client-Platform header) intentionally omits session_token from JSON body and only sets the httpOnly cookie. Metro proxy on localhost:3001 serves the Expo native manifest — respond only when expo-platform header is present; response is a JSON object with launchAsset.url pointing to /index.bundle on the preview host and extra.expoClient.name=RealAICoach. /health on localhost:8001 works but is not exposed via preview ingress (only /api/* is).
